messages:
emily_cs: Heads-up: ClinicFlow triggered two budget alerts yesterday and wants a concise QBR appendix focused on cost drivers + a recommended remediation path. QBR Thurs week.
usage-bot: [automated] budget-alert clinicflow.app triggered 2026-06-10T04:18:12Z limit=750000 observed=1,120,540
rahul_eng: Quick scan shows a heavy ingestion job re-embedding entire patient notes every run. Snippet from trace:```job=nightly_reindex route=/v1/embeds model=embed-2x tokens=1,024,000 requests=420``` Looks like dedupe not running.
sophia_solutions: Recommend two remediation tracks: (1) short-term: dedupe + sliding-window cache to cut repeated embedding calls; (2) medium-term: move to incremental diffs + event-driven embeddings. I'll draft both playbooks.
emily_cs: Good. Dan, any preferred renewal posture for the AM?
dan_revops: Avoid heavy price asks. Propose: offer a 3-month "overage escrow" (prepaid buffer) to avoid service disruption, paired with a post-QBR enablement plan. If engineering can commit to implementing dedupe within 30 days, offer a 6-month commit at a modest discount.
rahul_eng: For the canary I can enable a sliding-window cache with this minimal config:```sliding_window_seconds: 86400
dedupe_threshold: 0.92
cache_max_items: 200000
apply_on_route: /v1/embeds``` Simulation in our harness usually shows 25-45% token reduction for heavy reindex patterns. I'll run a 72h sim and post CSV.
sophia_solutions: I'll prepare a 15-min asynchronous demo: (a) how to detect redundant embeddings; (b) a lightweight client-side dedupe snippet; (c) a checklist for infra gating.
emily_cs: Action items: rahul -> canary sim + per-route delta CSV by EOD Wed; sophia -> playbook + demo links by Wed; dan -> draft renewal language + overage escrow terms by Fri. I'll assemble QBR appendix draft Sat.
rahul_eng: Quick Q: Can we use a redacted sample of their reindex job payloads for the sim?
emily_cs: Legal cleared for redacted payloads under current agreement. Avoid any PHI, use synthetic text where necessary. Share results via secure drive.
dan_revops: For forecasting slide, include three lines: current run-rate, run-rate post-dedupe (conservative/optimistic), and recommended escrow size (1 month, 1.5x current daily peak). I'll draft pricing language with rollback clause if dedupe not implemented.
sophia_solutions: Example client-side dedupe pseudo:```seen = LRUSet(max_size=100000)
for doc in docs:
  hash = sha1(normalize_text(doc))
  if hash in seen: continue
  seen.add(hash)
  send_to_embed(doc)``` Also include server-side similarity threshold example using cosine > 0.92.
emily_cs: Timeline OK. If the canary confirms >=30% token reduction we push the 6mo commit + discount; otherwise we recommend escrow + short runway commit. :clipboard: If anyone sees PHI in samples flag immediately.
usage-bot: [automated] follow-up: canary-sim requested for account clinicflow.app by rahul_eng.
rahul_eng: Starting canary tonight. Will tag results in this thread when available.
sophia_solutions: I'll start the demo recording tomorrow and share a short link.
emily_cs: Thanks team. AM wants a one-pager plus appendix with the sim CSV and suggested contract language. Let's keep updates here. :thumbsup:
